name: Horror Mod
description: Spooky-fun Halloween things, one step at a time. Step 1: the Ghost, a clear see-through ghost that floats around, says a soft "wooo", and never hurts anyone. Step 2: the Super Phantom, a big dark phantom with glowing eyes that swoops by and attacks at night and snatches one little item (it drops everything it took when defeated). Step 3: the Mysterious Witch, a neutral witch who throws her own new potions (Bouncy, Glow, Bat, Slime Feet) only at whoever hits her. Castle Level 6: a spooky castle obstacle course (rock climbing, vine parkour, strays that blast you across a gap, a zip line, and the Level 7 Key that opens the gate).
